title: Banana Shake 🍌
author: Vanilla G
desc:
This program is for intermediate to advanced lifters. This program is to help you stop using fluff to fill your workouts and focus more on the muscles that need bringing up to create that x frame.

Please use smart progression with the rep ranges, once you can complete the top number of reps per each exercise, up the weight and then start from the bottom range. I also think x2 progression is a good method whereby you up the weight on the final set and aim for the lower number of reps. As the weeks progress you can add weight to set 1&2 whilst set 3 is always slightly ahead.

ex.note: This is the lift we want to push throughout the program. Everything else can tick over nicely for the duration. Do not compromise form for weight. Smooth clean reps are what we want

ss.note: Set the cable up at around where you hand hangs down below your waist. Ensure we are letting the hand come past mid body to get the best of the stretch and extra range of motion DBs dont provide

ex.note: Do these first so we can maximise our gains from the Pendulum squat next. I want to really hard sets here every time to pre exhaust you for the next exercise
Dont look at these like they've got no right to be here, your legs probably look like they do because you don't do these. Go heavy and use your knees not your feet and thank me later

ss.note: Do these standing or on a leg press with safeties on (or dont unrack it). Use control and go as deep as you can. Your calves will be on fire after these
Dont skip these, nice and slow reps. Really crunch your midsection when you do these and do not swing at the bottom. Come to a stop and then rep

ex.note:
Plate loaded, Smith machine or Barbell with spotter arms on the rack will suffice. Do not rush or bounce these reps, rest at the bottom not the top where triceps do all the work. 

Last set to failure

ss.note: We did cables earlier in the week so this is a nice variation. Bring up the weight to parallel and slowly bring it down under control

ex.note: Prime the posterior chain for the next exercise, 2 heavy sets with little in the tank
1 heavy set. This should be an all out effort. Focus on perfect form with the heaviest weight possible. Destroy your glutes
Dont neglect these because the ladies do them. Make them heavy, push from your knees not your feet. Bridge for higher glute activation
